name: workflow-map
description: Live workflow map: one row above the prompt (what is running, what is next, segmented progress) that expands into a card graph of parallel steps, plus a full stage-by-stage view, with your mid-plan interjections clearly marked.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language. auto = the language of your most recent prompt (Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese or English); English when unsure.
